GSPL-DET-001.statement: MUST NOT: Canonical IR MUST NOT contain wall-clock time unless seed declares time as semantic input. Impl: packages/ir-model/src/graph.ts. Tests: packages/compiler-core/test/mutation.test.ts

GSPL-DET-002.statement: MUST: Normalization idempotent: normalize(normalize(x))=normalize(x). Impl: seed-format/src/seed-ops.ts. Tests: property.test.ts

GSPL-DET-003.statement: MUST: Same input produces identical canonical bytes across all processes and OS. Impl: pipeline.ts. Tests: cross-process.test.ts

GSPL-SEED-001.statement: MUST: Canonical seed contains deterministic entropy and effect boundaries. Impl: seed.ts. Tests: seed-format/test/

GSPL-SEED-002.statement: MUST: Field-level HASHED/NON_HASHED/DERIVED policy. Impl: seed-ops.ts. Tests: canonicalization.test.ts

GSPL-IR-001.statement: MUST: Typed attributed directed multi-graph with region scoping. Impl: ir-model/src/graph.ts. Tests: ir-model/test/

GSPL-IR-002.statement: MUST: Graph normalization idempotent and order-independent. Impl: graph-ops.ts. Tests: property.test.ts

GSPL-GENE-001.statement: MUST: Gene types declare schema, canonicalization, validation, lowering, lifting. Impl: gene-protocol/src/types.ts. Tests: gene-protocol/test/

GSPL-GENE-002.statement: MUST: Gene registry immutable at runtime. Impl: defaults.ts. Tests: gene-protocol/test/

GSPL-RECON-001.statement: SHALL: Reconstruction from IR produces identical canonical bytes. Impl: ir-reconstructor.ts. Tests: sabotage.test.ts

GSPL-PLAN-001.statement: MUST: Operations have deterministic IDs, inputs, outputs, dependencies. Impl: expansion-plan.ts. Tests: compiler-core/test/

GSPL-HASH-001.statement: MUST: SHA-256 over canonicalized input material. Impl: seed-ops.ts. Tests: property.test.ts

GSPL-LIMIT-001.statement: SHALL: Resource limits enforced. Impl: pipeline.ts. Tests: adversarial-limits.test.ts

GSPL-PROV-001.statement: MUST: Every IR node carries provenance chain. Impl: ir-model/src/graph.ts. Tests: mutation.test.ts

GSPL-PACK-001.statement: SHALL: Canonical compilation uses exact locked packages. Impl: package-resolver/src/resolver.ts. Tests: package-resolver/test/
